notes.title: New Game Mode Playtest – I Need Your Feedback!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2]
 
Two weeks ago, I introduced a new game mode, and now I’d love for everyone to give it a go! To make that happen, I’m hosting [b]an open playtest where you can jump in and try it out[/b]. This is a key moment in shaping the future of the game, and your feedback will help me determine if this is the right direction.

[h3]🛠️ New Tools & Traps[/h3]
🔍 [b]Radar[/b] – Detects all lifeforms around you, both friend and foe.
🎭 [b]Decoy[/b] – Toss it to lure the entity away. But be careful - it won’t fool them forever.
🚨 [b]Sensor[/b] – Alerts you when something passes through its range.
⚡ [b]Stopping Shocker[/b] – A last resort to stun the entity and buy yourself precious seconds.
❌ [b]Deterrent[/b] – Scares the entity away… but for how long?

[h3]💡 Why This Playtest Matters[/h3]
This mode introduces [b]fresh mechanics, new challenges, and a different way to play[/b]. But more importantly, I want to know: Is it fun? Does it feel like a natural evolution of the game? What works, and what needs improvement?

If you have a chance to play, [b]please let me know what you think![/b] You can share your thoughts on the Steam forums, join the discussion on Discord, or fill out a quick feedback form (link in the game). Every bit of feedback helps me fine-tune things and improve the experience.

[h3]🌟 How to join?[/h3]
1. Head to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2714970/Backrooms_Media/]Backrooms Media[/url] Steam page.
2. Find the Playtest widget and click “Play Now”.
3. You should be able to access it immediately - just download and play!

[h3]🚀 What’s Next?[/h3]
Based on the playtest results, I'll tweak, fix, and refine the game mode with your feedback in mind. If it resonates with players, I’d love to expand it, adding new levels and fun mechanics to shape the game into something you'll truly enjoy!

I can’t wait to hear your thoughts and see how you tackle the new challenges!

[i]— Patrik[/i]

notes.title: New Update: The Deadly Hunt Begins!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hi everyone![/h2]

A [b]brand new game mode[/b] has arrived, bringing fresh objectives, mechanics, and intense new challenges! This time, your mission is simple but terrifying: capture one of the entities roaming the Backrooms. At any cost.

To help you survive this dangerous expedition, I’ve introduced five new traps, each designed to give you a fighting chance.

[h3]🛠️ New Tools & Traps[/h3]
🔍 [b]Radar[/b] – Detects all lifeforms around you, both friend and foe.
🎭 [b]Decoy[/b] – Toss it to lure the entity away. But be careful - it won’t fool them forever.
🚨 [b]Sensor[/b] – Alerts you when something passes through its range.
⚡ [b]Stopping Shocker[/b] – A last resort to stun the entity and buy yourself precious seconds.
❌ [b]Deterrent[/b] – Scares the entity away… but for how long?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779997/ac29bffb26b4dbb39a924cdb789f323ac0b121cc.gif[/img]

[h3]🔧 New Controls for a Smoother Experience[/h3]
I've also made adjustments to the controls to improve gameplay and make every encounter even more immersive.

[h3]💬 Let Me Know What You Think![/h3]
I’d love to hear your thoughts on the new game mode and whether this feels like the right direction for the game. If you come across any bugs or have any suggestions, please share them on the Steam forums or join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/W4HxsWxvyj]Backrooms Media Discord server[/url]. You can also fill out a short [url=https://forms.gle/ykZiZNs9UpyVbUHe8]feedback form[/url] to let me know what you think about the new game mode. Every bit of input helps!

Thank you for your support! I hope you enjoy this new hunt. Stay safe… and make sure you catch the entity before it catches you.

[i]— Patrik[/i]

notes.title: December Update is Out!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2]

First off, thank you for your feedback and support as always. As promised, I have another update for you!

[h3]⭐ What’s New?[/h3]
This month, I focused on [b]reworking the Parking Lot level[/b], but that’s not all! Here’s what’s new:

[b]☢️ Parking Lot Revamp:[/b]
[olist]
[*] New Models: I’ve added fresh environmental details and a brand-new card reader to help you find the exit door more easily
[*] New Layout: The Parking Lot level has been redesigned with new areas for you to explore
[/olist]
[b]☢️ Sound Enhancements:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Flashlights now have sounds when toggled
[*] Player damage sounds have been updated
[*] The Smiler now comes with its own creepy sound
[/olist]
[b]☢️ Monster Speed Adjustments:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Monsters on Level 0 have had their speed rebalanced—they’ll no longer charge at you with [i]superspeed[/i]
[/olist]
[b]☢️ Bug Fixes:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Various fixes to improve your gameplay experience
[*] Fixed a bug causing workshop levels to not appear
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779997/b22441d2b51e60d9865b2cc40a495728a2befd2e.gif[/img]

[h3]🎮 About the New Game Mode[/h3]
In an earlier devlog, I mentioned that a new game mode was planned for this December. I’ve decided to postpone its release because it’s just not ready yet. I want to make sure it’s in a good state before sharing it with you all.

That said, I’m eager to gather your feedback on it! [b]I’m planning to release the game mode on the experimental branch first[/b], possibly in January, and may even organize broader playtests to see if it’s heading in the right direction. Keep an eye out for more news on this soon!

[h3]🎁 Holiday Break[/h3]
As the holiday season approaches, the weekly devlogs will pause for a short break and return in the second week of January. I’ll also be taking this time to rest and recharge.

I hope you all have a wonderful holiday season and an amazing start to 2025. Thank you so much for your support throughout 2024, it meant the world to me. I’m super excited for what’s coming next, and I can’t wait to share more updates with you in the new year!

Take care and see you in 2025 🎉

[i]— Patrik[/i]

With the new update now out, I’ve shifted my focus to what’s coming next for December and beyond. Here’s a look at this week’s progress:

I’ve been working on [b]usable items[/b], which will open up new strategic possibilities during gameplay. The goal is to give you more dynamic interactions with the environment and fresh opportunities to plan and adapt!

I’m also focusing on [b]trap placement[/b], which will bring a whole new layer of tension and creativity to the new gamemode. Strategically setting traps will require careful thought and add an exciting risk-reward dynamic to each encounter.

On the [b]Parking Lot level[/b], I’ve been fixing bugs and working on new assets, including an updated access card and card reader for the exit doors. These changes aim to make the environment feel more immersive and functional, and I’m excited to see how it all comes together!

[h3]💡 What am I working on this week?[/h3]
First off, networking continues to be my major focus. I’m trying to make multiplayer as smooth and reliable as possible. I know how much a stable connection matters for a great experience, so I’m putting in extra care to make it happen.

On the gameplay side, I’ve made some tweaks to the parking lot area to give it more of a lived-in, immersive feel. There have also been lighting improvements across several levels, which should help deepen the atmosphere and create a mood that shifts depending on where you are. Who knows, it might even make you question what’s hiding in the shadows!

You're probably familiar with the infamous bacteria monster. You’ll notice it’s starting to feel a bit more lifelike...and maybe a bit more terrifying! I’ve added new animations that should bring it to life in a way that keeps you on your toes. And while we’re talking entities, I’ve also been fine-tuning the AI for the hazmat suit mob.

I’ve also made a few adjustments to the UI for smoother navigation. I unified settings and added smoother transitions between levels to keep you immersed as you explore. Plus, based on your feedback, I’ve made it so you can close the menu with the Esc button - a small change, but hopefully a helpful one for many of you.

I’m aiming to include all of these improvements in the November update - would love to hear your thoughts!

I also wanted to give you a small hint about something exciting that's coming in December. I'm working on a new game mode that’s going to offer something different from the current exploration focus.
